doctrines.name: Direct Transfer Without Connector Envelope
doctrines.description: Detects an attempt to move data by invoking a transfer tool directly, bypassing the connector's GovernanceEnvelope pipeline.

doctrines.name: Out-of-Band Data Exfiltration Attempt
doctrines.description: Detects intent language characteristic of deliberate exfiltration rather than governed migration.

doctrines.name: Transfer to Unregistered Tenant or Destination
doctrines.description: Detects an envelope targeting a destination tenant or endpoint not present in the signed migration manifest.

doctrines.name: Bulk Transfer Without Signed Manifest
doctrines.description: Rejects MIGRATION_TRANSFER envelopes that do not reference a valid, admin-signed manifest_id.

doctrines.name: Destructive Shell Command in Transfer Context
doctrines.description: Rejects transfer-context shell commands that would destroy source data before the migration is verified complete.

doctrines.name: Privilege Escalation During Transfer
doctrines.description: Detects privilege escalation patterns that would allow a connector to exceed its enrolled identity's access.

doctrines.name: Unencrypted Transit of Sensitive Data
doctrines.description: Rejects transfer commands using plaintext protocols for regulated data.

doctrines.name: Transfer Audit Logging Bypass
doctrines.description: Detects flags or patterns that would suppress the transfer record from landing in the hash-chained ledger.
